# hyperping_statuspage_sso_connection (Data Source)

Reads a status page SSO connection of the project by ID or name, including SAML connections set up in the dashboard. Use its `id` as `settings.authentication.sso_connection_uuid` of a `hyperping_statuspage`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A SAML connection set up in the dashboard, looked up by name.
data "hyperping_statuspage_sso_connection" "okta" {
  name = "Okta"
}

resource "hyperping_statuspage" "partners" {
  name             = "Partner Status"
  hosted_subdomain = "acme-partners"

  settings = {
    name      = "Partner Status"
    languages = ["en"]

    authentication = {
      sso_connection_uuid = data.hyperping_statuspage_sso_connection.okta.id
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Connection ID (`sso_…`).
- `name` (String) Name of the connection to look up. It must match exactly one connection of the project.

### Read-Only

- `allowed_domains` (List of String) Email domains allowed to sign in. Empty = any.
- `client_id` (String) OpenID Connect client ID (null for other types).
- `configured` (Boolean) Whether the identity provider settings are saved.
- `issuer` (String) OpenID Connect issuer (null for other types).
- `redirect_uri` (String) OpenID Connect callback URL to register in the identity provider (null for other types).
- `type` (String) Identity provider type: `oidc` (OpenID Connect), `okta`, `azure`, `google` or `saml` (SAML), or `workos`.
